featured_reviews.review_text:
Santosh is very professional. He visited and gave us an estimate, came a day latter and fixed our furniture. He is reliable, respectful and trustable.

One of the carved legs of our bed broke while moving. While other carpenters gave up in finding similar wood work leg, Santosh went out of his way and drove a long way to get it and fixed it. His charges were comparatively much better then other estimates. His work is thorough, he had an assistant who cleaned up after work. I’m very pleased with his service. I would highly recommend him, you won’t be disappointed.
